page.overview:
Who is Yellow-Tusked Old Elephant?

The is one of the three demons that dwelled in Lion Camel Cave on Lion Camel Ridge. He turned out to be the belonging to the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra.

The Yellow-Tusked Old Elephant has the head of an elephant, silver hair, golden eyes, an incredibly long trunk, knotted eyebrows, and a rugged torso.

The Yellow-Tusked Old Elephant escaped from Samantabhadra's control and began dwelling in Lion Camel Cave along with three other demons. When his sworn brothers the Azure Lion and the Golden-Winged Great Peng agreed to escort Tang Sanzang across the mountains in a palanquin after being defeated, the Old Elephant was infuriated and went to fight them himself.

Zhu Bajie was sent out to fight him, and the Yellow-Tusked Old Elephant easily defeated him by wrapping him up with his tongue. Zhu Bajie was taken back to Lion Camel Cave to be pickled alive, but Sun Wukong broke him out. Sun Wukong easily defeated the Old Elephant and make him too vow to escort Tang Sanzang.
